title: C. A. graaf van Rechteren (St Petersburg) to the Griffier / States General, 23 Sept / 4 Oct 1785 (DECODE R1039)

documents.shelfmark: Nationaal Archief, 1.01.02 Staten-Generaal, inv. 7407; DECODE R1039

plaintext.source: Contemporary Griffie decipherment headed 'Ont cyfferde Missive', DECODE images 5448-5449, keyed to the cipher rows by margin group numbers.

transcription.source: DECODE manual transcription DOC_R1039_D3590_3590.txt (IB, 2020) for the cipher; decipherment transcribed by the model from the authenticated scans.
transcription.notes: Cipher groups parsed from images 5451-5452 of the DECODE transcription; 310-word decipherment read from images 5448-5449.

system.summary: Numerical code of up to three digits with dots and bars over single digits that are part of the code; Rechteren's legation code (NA legation in Russia inv. 158, not online).
system.notes: Groups separated by commas; key not rebuilt.

prior_solution.where: The Griffie's 1785 decipherment on the same DECODE record, images 5448-5449, transcribed by DECODE as cleartext.

conditions.human_role: Posed the target from the catalogue; DECODE account cookie.

solution.what: Checked repo notes (deswart1782: Rechteren key missing) and de Leeuw 2000, which cites this letter for letter-opening in Russia without printing it.
Fetched the DECODE record page, five images and the 2020 transcription with the stored cookie.
Applied the provisional R2051 and R2052 Rechteren-family keys (marks dropped) to the 424 groups.
Read images 5448-5449 from the scans: headed 'Ont cyfferde Missive', same dates and Secreet as the cipher; transcribed the 310-word decipherment.
Margin numbers of the decipherment (688, 107, 94.., 34..) match the last groups of cipher rows 1-4.

outcome.method_basis: The Griffie's 1785 decipherment ('Ont cyfferde Missive') is bound with the cipher on the same DECODE record (images 5448-5449); the project transcribed it from the scans and matched its margin numbers to the cipher rows.
outcome.notes: Read at the time; decipherment on the record. Key not rebuilt; the pair is a known-plaintext sample for R1040 (deswart1782).
